فَهَّةٌ and ↓ فَهَاهَةٌ [each of which has been mentioned above as an inf. n.] Lack of power or ability; (S, K:) as also ↓ فَهْفَهَةٌ (K.) ―
-b2- The first signifies also A case, or an (??), of فَهَاهَة: and [a case, or an instance, of] unmindfulness or forgetfulness: (TA:) and a (??) fault and a case, or an instance, of ignorance; and the like thereof. (A 'Obeyd. S. TA. *)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
